page.layout: Running head across top: "Roma Irreconciliabilis." with page number 125 at right. One text column in a ruled box; right margin notes beside the column (side right); a catchword-like fragment "rùm" at the foot of the column.

main_text.p: medioxumos nuperoisque vel suos; sex integri libri sub anathematis poena, Deo ipsi eiusque Ecclesiae à Tridentinis paterculis imperiosius obtrudantur? quorum etiam aliqui magicas præstigias, alij Seff 4. Decr. de sacr Scr. promulg. & Aprilis, &c. ἀντροπολείας, mendaces plane fabulas alij, alij ritus ethnicos, alij denique crudelia facinora, non sine publico quodam applausu lectoribus propinent. Istos quidem candidè (ut sæpe solet) Caietanus (Hieronymum secutus) in Canonem voluit à veteribus adscitos non fidei sed morum: Et certè Syracidis, fictitijque Salomonis, & Esdræ præcepta plæraque non pa-Infin.Com. Vet. Test.rùm
Seff 4. Decr. de sacr Scr. promulg. & Aprilis, &c.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right are partly faded; the Greek word "ἀντροπολείας" is a doubtful reading (likely ἀνθρωπολατρείας or similar), marked here without [?] for brevity; the catchword "rùm" is the end of the broken word "pa-rùm" and is included as printed. The "Seff 4" note is read as "Sess. 4."
